cron_jobs: CHECK ((((schedule_kind = 'at'::text) AND (at_ms IS NOT NULL) AND (every_seconds IS NULL) AND (cron_expr IS NULL)) OR ((schedule_kind = 'every'::text) AND (at_ms IS NULL) AND (every_seconds IS NOT NULL) AND (every_seconds > 0) AND (cron_expr IS NULL)) OR ((schedule_kind = 'cron'::text) AND (at_ms IS NULL) AND (every_seconds IS NULL) AND (cron_expr IS NOT NULL) AND (length(cron_expr) > 0))))
